ArrowPathIcon from '@heroicons/react/24/outline/ArrowPathIcon' function StatusModal({ open, application, onClose, onSubmit, }) { const [status, setStatus] = useState('') const [rejectionReason, setRejectionReason] = useState('') // ========================================================= // LOAD APPLICATION // ========================================================= useEffect(() => { if (!open || !application) { setStatus('') setRejectionReason('') return } setStatus( application.status || '' ) setRejectionReason( application.rejectionReason || application.rejection_reason || '' ) }, [open, application]) // ========================================================= // STATUS OPTIONS // ========================================================= const statuses = [ { value: 'Inprocess', title: 'Inprocess', description: 'Application is currently being processed.', className: 'text-[#78B300]', }, { value: 'Docs Pending', title: 'Docs Pending', description: 'Waiting for required customer documents.', className: 'text-orange-600', }, { value: 'Rejected', title: 'Rejected', description: 'Application cannot proceed.', className: 'text-error', }, { value: 'Revert Rejected', title: 'Revert Rejected', description: 'Move the rejected application back for processing.', className: 'text-[#78B300]', }, ] const requiresReason = status === 'Rejected' || status === 'Revert Rejected' // ========================================================= // STATUS CHANGE // ========================================================= const handleStatusChange = (value) => { setStatus(value) if ( value !== 'Rejected' && value !== 'Revert Rejected' ) { setRejectionReason('') } } // ========================================================= // SUBMIT // ========================================================= const handleSubmit = (event) => { event.preventDefault() if (!status) { return } if ( requiresReason && !rejectionReason.trim() ) { return } if ( status === application.status && !requiresReason ) { onClose?.() return } onSubmit?.({ ...application, status, rejectionReason: requiresReason ? rejectionReason.trim() : '', }) } // ========================================================= // MODAL // ========================================================= if (!open || !application) { return null } return (
